name: Standing shoulder abduction
notes: UI-PRMD m07. Single-limb, authored for the CANONICAL working (right) side. Left-working subjects (s07, s10) must be mirrored with rehubai.datasets.uiprmd.mirror_lr before validation. Abduction angle = hip-shoulder-elbow (arm ray vs downward torso ray). Bands from empirical UI-PRMD correct ranges (working side): arm-down ~18, arm-up ~150-168; elbow kept near-straight (>=~145).
